body_markdown:
Tokyo Game Show is a celebration of the creators, developers, and communities shaping the future of gaming **.** As we celebrate 25 years of XBOX and over 20 years in Japan, Tokyo Game Show is an opportunity to recognize the players, creators, and developers who have helped define gaming culture.


During the XBOX Tokyo Game Show 2026 Broadcast, we offered players a look at what’s coming to XBOX from Activision, Bethesda, KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS, KOEI TECMO, and SEGA. The show featured 17 fresh gameplay reveals, announcements, a surprise release, and a world premiere.


We saw a new campaign trailer for ***Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4*** , launching October 23, 2026, while ***Fallout 76*** showed an animated trailer for its eerie new update, *The Slasher,* available now.


Studios throughout Asia and around the globe brought even more surprises. Serenity Forge unveiled a world premiere for ***Faraday Blues,*** Netmarble bought brand-new gameplay for ***Bloomwalker*** (which is now officially part of the beloved Ni No Kuni universe) ***,*** and SEGA revealed Japan as one of the locations coming to ***Crazy Taxi: World Tour*** .


We also saw new gameplay for ***Raji: Kaliyuga*** *, **Wo Long 2, Wings of Ember** and **Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement*** , a character reveal for ***Persona 4 Revival*** *,* and shared that ***Shape of Dreams*** is available to play on XBOX today *.*


And the broadcast ended with an unforgettable “one more thing” appearance by none other than Hideo Kojima. Check out our full recap below to catch up on everything shown during the broadcast.


### KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS Reveals the Talent Behind *PHYSINT’* s Lead Role


Just when it appeared that the XBOX Tokyo Game Show 2026 Broadcast had come to a close, legendary game creator Hideo Kojima appeared to reveal fresh updates on *OD – KNOCK* and *PHYSINT* , including that Swedish actor and producer Bill Skarsgård will portray the lead role in *PHYSINT* , sharing a new poster for the title featuring Skarsgård and Charlee Fraser. Read the full story[here](https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2026/09/17/physint-lead-role-bill-skarsgard-kojima-productions-xbox) .


### Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories Confirms Two Returning Characters


A new trailer for *Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories* reveals the return of Rutger and Lenja from Atelier Yumia. Now experienced members of the Aladiss Pioneering Team, the two will support Karia and her companions on their new adventure, with their interactions with new companions revealing new sides of both returning characters.[Wishlist now on XBOX Series X|S.](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/atelier-karia-the-night-kingdom-the-guide-of-memories/9N6HNLVW5RJV)


### Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement Unleashes New Gameplay Trailer


Japanese developer ArtPlay revealed an action-packed new gameplay trailer for *Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement* , coming in 2027. From legendary producer IGA (Koji Igarashi), *Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement* is a new metroidvania adventure set in the gothic world of 16th Century England. The new trailer showcases the game’s fast-paced 2.5D action, with protagonists Leo and Alex battling their way through formidable enemies while exploring a sprawling, cursed land.


### Bloomwalker’s New Trailer Reveals New Gameplay and Pocket Dimension


*Bloomwalker* unveiled a new trailer, this time showcasing the Pocket Dimension! Through a door inside the Moving House, the Pocket Dimension is a special, self-contained area where players can construct buildings and freely customize their surroundings. Alongside their Familiars and Higgledies, players can gradually transform the space into a lively home and enjoy the game’s crafting and housing experience.


Experience aheartfelt crafting adventure in *Bloomwalker* , driven not by the pressure to survive, but by the joy of bringing a broken world back to life. *Bloomwalker* is heading to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC. Play it on both console and PC at no additional cost with XBOX Play Anywhere. Wishlist today to stay updated.


### Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Reveals Campaign Trailer


Price is on the run, war has erupted on the Korean Peninsula, and a catastrophic weapon of war is on the verge of falling into the wrong hands. The October 23 launch date is fast approaching for *Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4* , with Campaign Early Access going live on October 16 for those who pre-order the Standard Digital Edition or Vault Edition of the game.


Watch the official Tokyo Games Show Campaign trailer for a deeper look at the elements in play. The stakes have never been higher, and with this much on the line, one wrong move could result in disastrous consequences for the world as we know it. This is *Modern Warfare 4* .


### Crazy Taxi: World Tour Reveals Japan Map


SEGA has revealed that Japan is one of the locations coming to *Crazy Taxi: World Tour.* A place beautifully suspended between two worlds, Japan’s historic neighborhoods and traditions sit alongside the bustling energy of the modern city. Players will be able to freely explore Japan’s exciting streets, get to know the locals, and pick up a souvenir or two. Get ready to fall in love with the land of the rising sun when *Crazy Taxi: World Tour* hits the streets in 2027! Wishlist now on XBOX Series X|S.


### Edge of Memories Set to Launch on November 5, 2026


Action-JRPG *Edge of Memories* has revealed its November 5 release date. Developed through a collaboration between a small French studio and veteran Japanese developers, this gorgeous anime-style world is threatened by a mysterious disease that corrupts the land as you progress through the story, opening new paths in areas you’ve already explored.


Join Eline and her companions on a journey to stop the spread of the Corrosion and save their home. The latest trailer showcases the Japanese dub, featuring a cast of renowned Japanese voice actors. Whether you’re playing in English or Japanese, pre-order *Edge of Memories* now on XBOX Series X|S.


### Fallout 76: The Slasher Premieres New Animated Trailer


In *Fallout 76’s* new animated trailer for its latest update, *The Slasher,* Vault Boy comes face to face with the Pint-Sized Slasher Imposter…


Available now for all *Fallout 76* players, *The Slasher* brings a new eerie storyline unfolding over multiple weeks that evokes a certain waist-high menace from the days before the Great War. An emergency broadcasts lead players to unravel the mystery behind a spree of masked murders, with tasks ranging from fighting Infestations of fanatical Slasher supporters to digging up unmarked graves for clues. Corner the villain behind the grisly spree for the chance at a unique Power Armor set, a new Super Slasher weapon, and a chance to rest easy that night.


### Faraday Blues Unveiled in World Premiere


*Faraday Blues* made its world premiere during the XBOX Tokyo Game Show Broadcast, revealing Serenity Forge’s surreal sci-fi adventure about a daughter searching for parents who don’t know she exists. Players will collect and play character cards to rewrite tragic choices across three interconnected visual novels, with decisions carrying forward through three distinct eras and visual styles. The game features 64 reality-altering endings, where changing one moment can reshape an entire family’s future. *Faraday Blues* is coming to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, and cloud. Play it on both console and PC at no additional cost with XBOX Play Anywhere. Wishlist it now on the XBOX Store.


### GACHIAKUTA: BREAKOUT Gets Extended Gameplay Trailer


Based on the hit TV anime, *GACHIAKUTA: BREAKOUT* is a survival action RPG featuring intense melee-focused combat. Explore the vibrant world of Gachiakuta, brought to life with premium cartoon-style rendering and evocative visual design. During the XBOX Tokyo Game Show Broadcast, we saw an extended look at new gameplay. *GACHIAKUTA: BREAKOUT* is coming toXBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC in 2027. Play it on both console and PC at no additional cost with XBOX Play Anywhere.


### A Fresh Look at Genigods: Nezha with Developer Commentary


*Genigods: Nezha* is an original hardcore action RPG rooted in ancient Chinese genesis mythology. Players step into the role of the Spirit Pearl – the primal life essence crafted by Goddess Nüwa – reincarnated as the legendary Nezha to embark on an epic primordial adventure. Developed by the 20-year veteran team at Genigods Lab, this hardcore action RPG reimagines ancient Chinese creation mythology for a global audience.


Join Producer Young and Creative Director Erdi in a new developer diary for *Genigods: Nezha* . Explore a world born from the remains of primordial giant Pangu, fluid aerial divine combat, Nezha’s seven transforming relics, and the profound themes of defiance, life, and rebirth woven into this re-imagined mythic journey. *Genigods: Nezha* is coming to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC soon. Play it on both console and PC at no additional cost with XBOX Play Anywhere.


### Hope in the City is coming to XBOX and PC November 10, 2026


Anticipated narrative mystery *Hope in the City* is coming to XBOX – and soon. A new trailer, exclusive to the showcase, offered a deeper look at teenage Hope’s investigation of her parents’ sudden disappearance, relying on her artist’s eye and sketchbook. Canadian studio Lofty Sky Games revealed that the title will be on XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC. Play it on both console and PC at no additional cost with XBOX Play Anywhere.


### Once Human Announces October 22 Launch date for Biggest Expansion Ever on XBOX


*Once Human* , the free-to-play strange worlds survival game, unveiled a new trailer for its upcoming Ocean Expansion: Isles of Abyss – its largest free content update to date. The update brings full ship-building, island-and-ocean dual survival, deep-sea exploration, and terrifying endgame boss encounters.


The trailer presents six survival rules for a forbidden sea where nothing is what it seems: ghost vessels drift with no living crew, the sea is hunting, and entire islands may begin to move. Isles of Abyss launches October 22, 2026 on XBOX Series X|S and is included with Game Pass.


### Persona 4 Revival Introduces Detective Naoto Shirogane


Atlus has released the latest character trailer for *Persona 4 Revival,* the upcoming remake of *Persona 4* . This new video introduces Naoto Shirogane, a member of the Special Investigation Team. The cool and sharp-witted high school detective Naoto Shirogane joins the protagonist in uncovering the truth behind a series of mysterious incidents, and brings a signature flair to the game’s combat. *Persona 4* *Revival* is scheduled for release on February 18, 2027, and will be available on XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, cloud, and included with Game Pass. Play it on both console and PC at no additional cost with XBOX Play Anywhere.


### Raji: Kaliyuga Gets An Extended Gameplay First Look


Developer Nodding Heads unveiled a first look at gameplay for *Raji: Kaliyuga* , alongside developer commentary. The video focused on the unique game systems at the core of the combat design in *Raji: Kaliyuga* . Set six years after the original game, *Raji: Kaliyuga* expands on the conflict, portraying not just a war among mortals but a cosmic struggle involving gods, asuras, and mystical forces. The sequel also makes bold new strides into a new genre, pivoting from the first game’s isometric interpretation of ancient India, into a full third person action-adventure. *Raji: Kaliyuga* is slated to launch on XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, cloud, and included with Game Pass. Play it on both console and PC at no additional cost with XBOX Play Anywhere.


### Shape of Dreams Launches Today on XBOX Series X|S and Game Pass


Surprise! *Shape of Dreams* is available today on XBOX Series X|S, and is available on day one with Game Pass. The new trailer cuts between animated story sequences and gameplay, following its Travelers into combat – including Cetus, the newest to join them – as Memories build up their power. One run’s end flows straight into the next, showing the roguelite loop at the core of the game, before four players take it on together. Cross-play is supported at launch, so XBOX players can team up with friends across other available platforms.


### Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember Reveals Powerful New Boss


Watch the newly revealed boss fight against Zuochi, a powerful demon, featuring a voice-over introduction by the game’s producer, Masakazu Hirayama! Learn key combat skills, then take on the Alpha Demo, available until September 30. Complete the Alpha Demo to claim your special reward: Fledgling Phoenix Helmet in the full game at launch! *Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember* launches March 4, 2027 for XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, and cloud. Play it on both console and PC at no additional cost with XBOX Play Anywhere. Pre-orders are now open.
